name: Perverted Tea House
source:
The game is set in a fictionary, dystopian multiverse inspired to the Progression Fantasy and Wuxia/Xianxia genres, spiced up with Cyberpunk elements.

The MC is the gifted student of the most renowned and feared Cultivator on the planet, set on discovering his heritage, and soon tasked with facing the biggest threat to the Universe: the Cursed God.

He will be helped by his Battle Group: a selected few among the most powerful and hot women of the Galaxy!

Will you be able to succeed? Under the Ruthless Heavens, appearances are deceitful, and it won't be easy to distinguish friend from for foe...

[From [url=https://saintmcdaniels.itch.io/perverted-tea-house]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该游戏以虚构的反乌托邦多元宇宙为背景，灵感来自于进阶奇幻和武侠/仙侠类型，并融入了赛博朋克元素。

MC是地球上最著名、最令人畏惧的修行者的天才学生，他着手发现他的遗产，并很快面临着面对宇宙最大威胁的任务：被诅咒的上帝。

他将得到他的战斗小组的帮助：从银河系最强大、最性感的女性中选出的少数人！

你能成功吗？狠天之下，外表是骗人的，敌友不易辨别……

[来自[url=https://saintmcdaniels.itch.io/perverted-tea-house]itch.io[/url]]
